SELECT 
  AVG(avg_product_price) AS avg_of_avg_prices,
  AVG(count_with_order_item_id) AS avg_of_counts
FROM (
  SELECT 
    i.invoice_number,
    AVG(ili.product_price) AS avg_product_price,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN ili.order_item_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS count_with_order_item_id
  FROM Invoices i
  LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items ili ON i.invoice_number = ili.invoice_number
  GROUP BY i.invoice_number
)
